raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

On ROCm without aiter (`SGLANG_USE_AITER` unset) and with vLLM installed, `layernorm.py` binds `fused_add_rms_norm` from `vllm._custom_ops`. vLLM's signature is the four-argument in-place op:

```
fused_add_rms_norm(input, residual, weight, epsilon) -> None
```

`RMSNorm.forward_hip` and the vLLM branch of `GemmaRMSNorm.forward_hip` called it with the six-argument out-of-place form `(out, x, residual_out, residual, weight, eps)`. The first forward that has a residual, the second decoder layer, failed:

```
TypeError: fused_add_rms_norm() takes 4 positional arguments but 6 were given
```

This is the same bug as the closed, unmerged #32034. #46915 fixes it on `amd_march` and does not target `main`. The aiter path is unchanged: with aiter enabled, `RMSNorm` uses `forward_aiter`, and `GemmaRMSNorm.forward_hip` returns before this call.

An empty batch is sent to `forward_native`. The vLLM HIP kernels fail to launch with an empty grid (`hipErrorInvalidConfiguration`).

## Modifications

`python/sglang/srt/layers/layernorm.py`

- `RMSNorm.forward_hip`, when `residual` is not `None`:
  - Add `post_residual_addition` into `residual` when it is present.
  - Make `residual` contiguous. vLLM's kernel requires that.
  - Call `fused_add_rms_norm(x, residual, self.weight.data, self.variance_epsilon)` and return `(x, residual)`.
  - Drop the `out` and `residual_out` allocations.
  - If `x.numel() == 0`, return `forward_native` before the HIP call.
- `GemmaRMSNorm.forward_hip`, vLLM branch only (`_use_aiter` is false): the same change, using `self.gemma_weight`. The comment above that call now documents the four-argument in-place signature. The no-residual `rms_norm(out, x, weight, eps)` call is unchanged.

`test/registered/unit/layers/test_layernorm_hip_vllm.py`

- CPU test registered in `base-a-test-cpu` (`est_time=5`).
- Forces `_use_aiter=False` and `_has_vllm_rms_norm=True`, and patches `fused_add_rms_norm` with a reference that has vLLM's exact signature and in-place semantics: `residual += input`, then `input = rms_norm(residual) * weight`.
- `RMSNorm`: hidden size 64, 0 and 7 tokens, no `post_residual_addition`.
- `GemmaRMSNorm`: 0 tokens, and 7 tokens with and without `post_residual_addition`.
- Each case compares `forward_hip` to `forward_native` with `torch.testing.assert_close`. A six-argument call fails this test because the reference accepts only four arguments.

## Accuracy Tests

No full-model GPU accuracy run was done for this PR. The old six-argument call did not execute, so there is no previous kernel output to compare.

The CPU unit test above is the accuracy check. `forward_hip` must match `forward_native` for both the output and the residual. That has not been executed in the environment where this branch was prepared; `base-a-test-cpu` should run `test/registered/unit/layers/test_layernorm_hip_vllm.py`.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No serving benchmark or profile was collected. The residual path no longer allocates `out` and `residual_out`. That should be neutral or slightly cheaper, and it does not change the aiter kernels.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). Pre-commit was not run on this branch.
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). Added `test/registered/unit/layers/test_layernorm_hip_vllm.py`. It still needs to be run in CI.
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). No documentation change. The public API is unchanged; this only makes the existing non-AITER HIP path callable.
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). No GPU accuracy or speed run. The CPU unit test is described above.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance). The edit matches the surrounding `layernorm.py` style. Pre-commit was not run.

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

**With vLLM's real kernel.** `RMSNorm(4096)` / `GemmaRMSNorm(4096)` `forward_hip` vs `forward_native`, bf16, same inputs. gfx1100 uses vLLM 0.31.0 and torch 2.13 (ROCm 7.2); gfx1201 uses the `rocm/vllm` ROCm 10.0 image (vLLM 0.27.1, torch 2.12).

| case | main | this PR (both cards) |
|---|---|---|

| `GemmaRMSNorm`, 7 tokens, with `post_residual_addition` | same `TypeError` | matches (max abs diff 0.031 on gfx1100, 0.016 on gfx1201) |
| 0 tokens | same `TypeError` | OK |

**End to end, gfx1100** (`sglang.launch_server`, context length 8192, then gsm8k with 100 questions)

| model | main | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| Qwen3-8B (`RMSNorm`) | fails at startup with the same `TypeError` | serves, gsm8k 95% |
| Qwen3.5-9B (`GemmaRMSNorm`) | fails at startup with the same `TypeError` | serves, gsm8k 97% |

I didn't run end to end on gfx1201, because the image I use there has no vLLM build. No throughput numbers; this is a correctness fix.

+            #           fused_add_rms_norm(input, residual, weight, eps) -> None (in place)

@@ -0,0 +1,85 @@
+"""On ROCm without aiter, RMSNorm and GemmaRMSNorm with a residual must call vLLM's
+fused_add_rms_norm with its in-place (input, residual, weight, epsilon) signature
+and match forward_native."""
+
+import unittest
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.layers import layernorm
+from sglang.srt.layers.layernorm import GemmaRMSNorm, RMSNorm
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+HIDDEN = 64
+
+
+def _vllm_fused_add_rms_norm(
+    input: torch.Tensor, residual: torch.Tensor, weight: torch.Tensor, epsilon: float
+) -> None:
+    # Reference for vllm._custom_ops.fused_add_rms_norm: residual += input, then
+    # input = rms_norm(residual) * weight, both in place.
+    residual.add_(input)
+    r = residual.float()
+    normed = r * torch.rsqrt(r.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + epsilon)
+    input.copy_((normed * weight.float()).to(input.dtype))
+
+
+def _vllm_rms_norm(
+    out: torch.Tensor, input: torch.Tensor, weight: torch.Tensor, epsilon: float
+) -> None:
+    x = input.float()
+    normed = x * torch.rsqrt(x.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + epsilon)
+    out.copy_((normed * weight.float()).to(out.dtype))
+
+
+class TestLayerNormHipVllm(CustomTestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        self.patches = [
+            patch.object(layernorm, "_use_aiter", False),
+            patch.object(layernorm, "_has_vllm_rms_norm", True),
+            patch.object(
+                layernorm, "fused_add_rms_norm", _vllm_fused_add_rms_norm, create=True
+            ),
+            patch.object(layernorm, "rms_norm", _vllm_rms_norm, create=True),
+        ]
+        for p in self.patches:
+            p.start()
+        torch.manual_seed(0)
+
+    def tearDown(self):
+        for p in reversed(self.patches):
+            p.stop()
+
+    def _check(self, layer, num_tokens, post):
+        x = torch.randn(num_tokens, HIDDEN)
+        residual = torch.randn(num_tokens, HIDDEN)
+        post_add = torch.randn(num_tokens, HIDDEN) if post else None
+        ref_out, ref_residual = layer.forward_native(
+            x.clone(), residual.clone(), None if post_add is None else post_add.clone()
+        )
+        out, out_residual = layer.forward_hip(x.clone(), residual.clone(), post_add)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(out, ref_out)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(out_residual, ref_residual)
+
+    def test_rms_norm_with_residual(self):
+        layer = RMSNorm(HIDDEN, eps=1e-6)
+        with torch.no_grad():
+            layer.weight.normal_(mean=1.0, std=0.1)
+        for num_tokens in (0, 7):
+            with self.subTest(num_tokens=num_tokens):
+                self._check(layer, num_tokens=num_tokens, post=False)
+
+    def test_gemma_rms_norm_with_residual(self):
+        layer = GemmaRMSNorm(HIDDEN, eps=1e-6)
+        layer.weight.weight_loader(layer.weight, torch.randn(HIDDEN) * 0.1)
+        for num_tokens, post in ((0, False), (7, False), (7, True)):
+            with self.subTest(num_tokens=num_tokens, post=post):
+                self._check(layer, num_tokens=num_tokens, post=post)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
